title: Concrete filtered homology exact couple
statement: Let $C$ be abelian, $K$ a cochain complex and $F$ a decreasing filtration. The filtered homology exact couple $X$ [def-sp-exact-couple] has exactly the explicit terms and maps of [def-sp-filtered-homology-couple-data]. Its six proof fields are supplied by [lem-sp-filtered-homology-couple-exactness]; no object or morphism is selected from an existential theorem. At $(P,Q)=(2p+q,-p)$ its initial $E$ term is canonically identified with $H^{p+q}(\operatorname{gr}^pK)$ by the equality of the filtration and homology indices. Denote this equality isomorphism by $e_0^{p,q}$.

lean.note: §1(B) interface repair. The published compiler binding of filteredHomologyExactCouple and filteredHomologyEIso has sorry data, so D cannot reduce to filtration-step homology; the archived source instead calls ofShifted, which is absent from the current upstream BigradedExactCouple API. Construct the existing BigradedExactCouple directly with the five explicit filteredHomologyD/E/Alpha/F/G terms and maps, the six proof fields from filteredHomologyCouple_exact, and the real equality isomorphism filteredHomologyEIso. No object or morphism is chosen from an existence assertion; the mathematical notion and all exported names and signatures are preserved.
